Zimbabwe has become a significant producer of cesium with its Bikita mine expansion; data is relatively recent and reliable from mining reports and industry sources.
Namibia produces cesium as a byproduct from spodumene mining, with moderate data availability and estimates based on regional reports.
Russia has limited cesium production with some operations reported, though data is less complete and more approximate.
Brazil's cesium production is minor but notable; data is limited and somewhat outdated, thus confidence is lower.
